scope: baseline feasibility and error decomposition only; no JEPA, no future prediction, no new algorithm

dataset.name: Sugar4D
dataset.test_caveat: held out from these pretrained models, but previously used in M3/M4; not a fresh confirmatory cohort
dataset.pepper_policy: attempt official download; if unavailable do not claim cross-species validation

pipelines.B0: current GT leaf instance masks relabeled independently at every scan + official TrackPlant3D CPD and extended MWPM
pipelines.B1: fixed official PlantNet epoch199 checkpoint, XYZ-only zero-shot predictions + same TrackPlant3D adapter
pipelines.B2: same B1 instances + normalized current centroid Hungarian matching, 0.25 distance gate; no registration
pipelines.B2_GT: diagnostic only: B0 masks + B2 matcher; never substitute for B2 primary
pipelines.PSegNet: download and runtime smoke audit only; do not select between networks using target scores

segmentation.input: XYZ only, all raw points included before geometry-only sampling
segmentation.sampling: deterministic uniform without replacement, no label stratification
segmentation.normalization: current scan centered and unit sphere; no temporal or GT alignment
segmentation.cluster_filter: official 1% public mean_ins_size for majority semantic class
segmentation.dense_prediction: nearest sampled XYZ label and confidence propagation
primary_metrics: SBD: min of directional mean best Dice
segmentation.evaluation_resolution: full raw PLY points, not only 4096 samples

tracking.sampling: official 3DEPS: Open3D boundary, 4096 random edge/core, FPS 128 each; fixed seeds
tracking.dummy_cost: official extend_matrix: 0.9 times nearest real cost
tracking.primary_metric: plant-macro observation IDF1 after full-sequence evaluation-only one-to-one GT/track alignment
secondary_metrics: end-to-end adjacent GT identity link recall
tracking.unknown disappearance: tracker termination is not biological death
tracking.confidence: semantic max-softmax times current assignment margin; heuristic, not calibrated probability

events.definition: first observation of a GT organ after initial scan; not botanical emergence
events.matching: same scan IoU > 0.5 frame association; tracker new ID is positive event

measurement.method: fixed geometry baseline: PCA major-axis 1%-99% span (cm); planar PCA convex hull (cm2)
measurement.labels: released total length and leaf area are evaluation-only automatic references; final length manual reference secondary
measurement.diagnostic_oracle: evaluator may use true within-frame association and true adjacent GT links solely to isolate error propagation
measurement.sampling: at most 4096 evenly indexed points within each full-resolution mask
measurement.growth: difference across adjacent actual scans, signed change and per-day rate; no future prediction
measurement.missing: NaN plus explicit coverage; never silently zero morphology
measurement.primary_error: relative absolute error, all eligible GT organs included via clipped loss min(error,2); missing measurements receive loss 2
measurement.severe_change: absolute change error / max(previous reference,1) > 0.5 or missing
measurement.area_caveat: planar convex hull is an imperfect area proxy, no independent manual area or longitudinal biological truth

acceptance.split: test; validation reported separately; no tuning on either
acceptance.paired_ci: 10000 bootstrap resamples of independent plants; seed 20261012; differences B1-B0 and tracker-minus-evaluation-oracle

decision.PIVOT: engineering/identity evidence inadequate, or every diagnostic including GT masks and GT temporal evaluation links cannot support auditable measurements
decision.INSTANCE-FIRST: B1 PQ fails and B1 minus B0 IDF1 <= -0.15, with B0 sufficiently better to localize segmentation as major bottleneck
decision.TRACKING-FIRST: B0 tracking IDF1 fails and oracle-frame measurement is materially better; identity loss dominates despite adequate masks
decision.MEASUREMENT-FIRST: identity is adequate or segmentation is not demonstrated dominant, but oracle-mask/oracle-link measurement or confidence fails
